999_cirno · Nov 28, 2026

Hey I'm in the market for this!

The old trusty workhorse Sketch crippled itself in futile attempt to compete with Figma (most likely because they were under pressure after receiving $20 mil from Benchmark in 2019.)

Anyway, they added a bunch of cloud features and started constantly phoning home. We use Little Snitch to block outgoing connections, and Sketch periodically decides that it's no longer activated, triggering a modal state that also sometimes causes loss of current doc. So you notice that the UI is frozen and have to do the dance: unblock for a moment, re-enter the license, block again. Such annoyance as it was a great product and we used to regularly purchase updates.
